articles.title: Cyberattack hits hundreds of French supermarkets, heating fridges to 122°F and sparking fires
articles.description: Hackers targeted hundreds of French supermarkets in a large-scale cyberattack, causing refrigerators to overheat, spoiling food, and sparking fires.

articles.title: Anthropic warns AI models could soon copy themselves across home devices
articles.description: Anthropic's latest research adds to the growing safety concerns around AI from the ability for models to carry out cyberattacks to the technology going rogue.

articles.title: Micron, SoftBank and ASML slide as Wall Street chip rout spreads
articles.description: Technology stocks tumbled Tuesday as a sell-off in U.S. semiconductor shares spilled into Asian and European markets.

articles.title: U.S. Treasury yields fall as energy prices pull back
articles.description: Bond yields fell on Tuesday as investors await more economic data releases this week.

articles.title: CNBC Daily Open: 'Boring' trumps disorder and volatility
articles.description: Some warning lights are flashing on the global economy dashboard.

articles.title: As 'Cockroach' protests grow over alleged voter fraud, Modi defends India as ‘mother of democracy’

articles.title: Visa gets Beijing's green light for bank card business after 40 years of working with China
articles.description: The incremental approval comes as the U.S. and Chinese presidents are due to meet for a third time this year next month.

articles.title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
articles.description: A bitcoin whale that received coins days before the Covid crash and sat through it has moved millions on-chain.

articles.title: Blur is shutting down its website, so why are NFT collectors cheering?
articles.description: Blur’s planned website closure revived criticism of the royalty policies and token rewards that helped it overtake OpenSea during the NFT boom, but hurt creators.

articles.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
articles.description: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

articles.title: World Bank jobs council urges 'crisis-era' employment support measures as IMF warns of AI ‘tsunami’
articles.description: IMF Chief Kristalina Georgieva warned AI is hitting the global labor market like a “slow-moving tsunami,” with young workers entering the job market the most exposed.

articles.title: Binance to shut down crypto mining pool services in November
articles.description: Binance will discontinue its mining pool and related services on Nov. 10, urging miners to move to alternative pools before the shutdown.

articles.title: IMF warns bond yields could see a 'disorderly' spike as debt, inflation risks worsen
articles.description: The IMF says risks in the government bond market have worsened and that yields could jump sharply and disorderly.

articles.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
articles.description: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.

articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $83,000 as it decouples from tumbling Korean stocks and Nasdaq futures
articles.description: Bitcoin climbed back above $83,000 after an early dip, decoupling from a sharp slide in Korean chip stocks and weakness in Nasdaq futures ahead of Thursday’s US CPI report.

articles.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits
articles.description: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, warning that resilience is tested by energy constraints and looming fiscal risks.

articles.title: Oil prices fall as traders assess Russian diesel supply prospects and Saudi-Houthi conflict
articles.description: Oil prices fell as investors assess potential supply disruptions against prospects of more Russian diesel entering global markets.

articles.title: Higher rates could be needed to avoid 'inflationary mindset' taking hold, says Fed's Hammack
articles.description: The Cleveland Fed president said that tighter monetary policy would be needed to bring down inflation.

articles.title: South Korea moves to block 27 crypto websites, including KuCoin, MEXC
articles.description: Authorities said the restrictions are aimed at unregistered exchanges and have acknowledged that customers could have difficulty withdrawing assets.
